subject: Modernize remote connection UX while preserving session state
body:
Modernize remote connection UX while preserving session state

Centralize managed PuTTY profiles, prevent unwanted IME capture in SSH, embed the VNC runtime dependency, refresh connection icons with source attribution, and preserve RDP aspect ratio without resizing SmartSize sessions.

Constraint: SmartSize must not renegotiate Linux/xRDP desktop dimensions.

Rejected: Dynamic SmartSize session resize | it can create or resume a different Linux work session.

Confidence: high

Scope-risk: moderate

Directive: Preserve mRemoteNG brand icons and keep third-party license/source manifests with redistributed assets.

Tested: x64 Debug build; RDP resize policy smoke harness; live reconnect to the existing Linux desktop.

Not-tested: Full mRemoteNGTests build remains blocked by the pre-existing OptionsRepositoryTests CS1503 OptionsStore/ISettingsStore mismatch.

Co-authored-by: OmX <omx@oh-my-codex.dev>
